name: Sample medallion conventions (reference platform)
note: Stand-in conventions until the customer's engineering standards are supplied. All generated SQL is compiled from these rules, not free-typed by the model.

rules: Raw copy of the source table; every source column kept as-is (VARCHAR in, no business logic).
Append-only; one batch id per load.
snake_case column names; business-friendly names chosen in the mapping.
Typed columns (DATE, DECIMAL(14,2), INTEGER, VARCHAR) with explicit casts using try_cast / try_strptime.
De-duplicate on the business key, keeping the latest ingested record.
Rows failing key or type rules go to {entity}__quarantine with a reject_reason; they never disappear silently.
PII columns are hashed (sha256) and never stored in clear text.
Part numbers are standardised and mapped to the product hierarchy; mapping status kept per row.
Facts at the lowest useful grain with conformed dimension attributes (date, product hierarchy, region).
Measures are registered in the semantic layer (meta.measures) with a definition and a source reconciliation query.
Report marts (rpt_*) are aggregated at the grain the report needs and are rebuilt from gold facts only.
